payload.title: Rust server feature ports: search, web-push, outbound email, OTel export
payload.description: Feature surfaces present in the TS server but not yet ported to frick-server: the custom search adapter, the web-push (VAPID) push adapter (APNs+FCM are done), outbound email (EmailAdapter/Resend), and OpenTelemetry export (the FRICK_OTEL_* env vars are documented but not parsed by frick-server config). Calls/WebRTC is tracked separately as FR-15. Some docs/compose still reference these (KafkaJS/jose naming, OTel rows) and should be reconciled as each lands.
